dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Hmm? You've not heard of me? Well, I suppose you don't look like researchers on the cutting edge either.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Bossuet's the name. I once worked at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: If you have time to visit the Institute, I'm sure you'll find many an academic achievement credited to me, and researchers who have received my mentorship.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Ah, but that said, I'm not providing professional guidance at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: I've retired from my research post, and am here in peaceful retirement. If you wanted professional aid, I fear I must disappoint you.
